goal: Agent Zero Conversation Intelligence plugin: improve retrieval accuracy, date-filter correctness, latency and context relevance via a local stub harness (no live Agent Zero, no network, no real LLM).
iterations_executed: 12 loop iterations (15 numbered trials incl. sub-trials; see results.tsv)
metric_notes: Relevance metric was refined twice during the run and the baseline re-measured transparently: (1) purity -> B-cubed F1 (penalizes fragmentation AND coalescence), (2) coverage corpus restricted to non-finance threads with data-driven expected threads (seed-robust). Refinements are harness-side instrumentation; plugin code was re-measured before/after each.

Latency is dominated by the (stubbed) vector scan; plugin-side overhead is ~1ms and further micro-optimizations measured below run-to-run noise (~0.5ms), so iteration 12 (latency bundle) was reverted per the no-noise-level-gain rule.
kept_changes: helpers/conversation_search.py: robust parse_date_bound (YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY/MM/DD, ISO-8601 T/Z/offset -> naive UTC), invalid-range guard, garbage-date -> [], widened server-side pushdown + authoritative client-side refilter, overfetch x4, min-max normalized recency-blended rerank (w=0.6, deterministic tie-break)
helpers/memory_documents.py: parse_memory_timestamp extended to ISO-8601 variants with UTC normalization, lru_cache(1024)

helpers/thread_detector.py: overlap coefficient (intersection/min) replaces Jaccard; suggested-slug collision disambiguation; exact-slug + any-overlap weak-evidence merge rule; last_activity keeps max under out-of-order processing
helpers/context_store.py: get_top_threads recency-decay ranking (14d half-life, relative to newest thread activity, wall-clock independent)
discarded_changes: recency-decay applied before the merge fix (fragmented counts masked the effect)

regression_gates.datefilter: 10/10 checks pass at every kept iteration (inclusive bounds, next-day exclusion, no-filter, invalid range, ISO-T, Z-suffix, tz-offset UTC conversion, slash input, garbage input)
regression_gates.pytest: 7 passed (4 harness gates + 3 thread-detector regression tests)

safety.note: Local commit 17d6a35 (iterations 1-10) was created during a session pause segment; no push performed. Working tree holds iterations 11-14 uncommitted.

next_steps: Wire rerank/recency knobs (RECENCY_WEIGHT, half-life) into default_config.yaml for operator tuning
Port client-side date refilter guard into tools/conversation_search.py error path (already graceful via memory_load)
If a real FAISS backend becomes available, re-run harness against it to validate latency findings
